evidence: Carries the P2P label, modifies 'src/net.h', and manages connection bounds to protect the transaction orphanage.
rationale: Prevents a deterministic node crash in the transaction orphanage when high peer counts are configured. The PR description notes that 'the orphanage can abort when more than 3,000 peers have orphan announcements' and clamping '-maxconnections' avoids this failure condition.
